about: One round budget per lap, shared by every check. A round is a fix that is checked again. Human-owned; see harness/README.md.

sources.review: a BMAD review loopback: the code is re-derived and reviewed again
sources.gates: a red local gate run, fixed and run again
sources.runtime: a failed runtime verification, fixed and verified again
sources.ci: a red required check on the pull request (CI or the factory judge), fixed and pushed
sources.main-moved: a merge of main that needed conflicts resolved or code changed to get green
